description: This script generates a CMake file containing devicetree data by processing an EDT object and its nodes, properties, and aliases. It uses command-line arguments for input/output paths and interacts with devicetree data structures.

methods.name: parse_args
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments for output and pickle file paths.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that loads devicetree data, processes nodes and properties, and generates a CMake target file.
